shorts.title: GTA 6 First Person: The Hidden View
shorts.description:
GTA 6 has no full first-person mode, but stand still, hold L2 (LT) and click the right stick for a first-person view. Don't click both sticks without L2, or you'll trigger Focus mode.
Would you play in first person? #gta6 #gtavi #shorts

shorts.title: GTA 6: Don't Farm Money in Chapter 1
shorts.description:
Guides say the cash you carry doesn't carry over when GTA 6's Chapter 1 ends. Spend what you need and play the story; the bigger money comes later.
Did you grind in Chapter 1? #gta6 #gtavi #shorts
